name: EPIC 201751428
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 9.2 solar radii and 0.82 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201751428 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.155649 (16th-84th percentiles 8.968088-9.423301), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,472 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 0.82 solar masses and 9.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,703 K at its surface.
